class.name: DSPreloader
class.brief_description: Static helper utility for collecting and prewarming scene texture assets.
class.description: [DSPreloader] provides a high-level static GDScript API over DirectStorage streaming and GPU decompression. It walks scene dependencies to discover texture paths, issues stream prewarm requests through [DSTextureCache], and coordinates with the [code]DSRuntime[/code] autoload for non-blocking scene loading. [b]Residency ownership:[/b] the texture cache pins prewarmed textures on purpose, so memory staying high after a scene swap is the expected design, not a leak. Releasing a scene's GPU resources is the game's job (drop the references, then call [code]DSTextureCache.clear_unused()[/code]); measure that release in bytes per second against the session's own best rate rather than a fixed millisecond budget. [DSPreloader] does not watch scene teardown and emits no warnings about it - do not wait for one.

method.name: await_prewarm_finished
method.description: Awaits completion of prewarm batch [param tag] across frame updates without blocking the main thread, optionally invoking [param on_progress] with [code](done, total)[/code] each frame. Returns [code]true[/code] when the batch completed, [code]false[/code] when the main loop is not a [SceneTree] or when the batch was declared stalled. [param stall_timeout_msec] is opt-in and defaults to [code]0[/code], which polls until completion with no timeout (the historical behaviour). When greater than zero it tracks a liveness fingerprint (progress plus the pending/unbuilt texture counters, because a batch can finish every request and still be building textures); after that many milliseconds without any change it emits one warning with a state dump, calls [method cancel_prewarm], invokes [param on_stall] with [code](tag, done, total)[/code] when valid, and returns [code]false[/code]. The cancelled tag reaches its terminal state on the next completion harvest, so a pump tick is still needed afterwards. Callers that ignore the return value keep working unchanged.

method.name: cancel_prewarm
method.description: Marks prewarm batch [param tag] as cancelled so pending requests terminate and [method is_prewarm_complete] evaluates to [code]true[/code].

method.name: collect_scene_textures
method.description: Recursively collects all prewarmable texture dependencies for [param scene_path], also sweeping [param extra_scan_dirs] for dynamically loaded assets.

method.name: get_prewarm_progress
method.description: Returns [code]Vector2i(completed, total)[/code] items processed for prewarm batch [param tag].

method.name: get_prewarm_state
method.description: Returns a one-call diagnostic snapshot of prewarm batch [param tag]: [code]progress[/code] ([Vector2i] done/total), [code]complete[/code] ([bool]), and the per-tag texture counters [code]pending[/code], [code]unbuilt[/code], [code]unbuilt_cpu[/code], [code]unbuilt_gpu[/code] ([int]), so a caller can log why a load did not finish without assembling several pollers. Every counter is probed with [method @GlobalScope.has_method] and reports [code]0[/code] on older native builds. An unknown tag reports [code]complete = true[/code], [code]progress = (0, 0)[/code] and zero counters, matching [method is_prewarm_complete].

method.name: is_gpu_prewarm_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if Direct3D 12 hardware GPU decompression prewarm directly into VRAM is supported and active.

method.name: is_prewarm_complete
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if all requests for prewarm batch [param tag] have finished and all textures are cached.

method.name: is_stream_prewarm_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the native DirectStorage streaming pipeline singletons are active AND a stream driver node is in the scene tree ([code]/root/DSRuntime[/code], or the legacy [code]/root/DSBatchManager[/code]). Both halves are required: the driver's [code]_process()[/code] is what submits and harvests the queue, so capability flags alone would let callers wait forever on requests nobody services.

method.name: load_scene_with_loading_screen
method.description: Orchestrates asynchronous prewarm, scene loading, instantiation, tree attachment, and frame settling under an active loading screen overlay.

method.name: prewarm_async
method.description: Enqueues texture [param paths] for asynchronous CPU memory streaming prewarm and returns the assigned batch tag. Returns [code]0[/code] when the native singletons or the stream driver autoload ([code]DSRuntime[/code]) are unavailable; a tag issued without that driver would never complete.

method.name: prewarm_gpu_async
method.description: Enqueues texture [param paths] for direct-to-GPU VRAM DMA streaming prewarm in chunks of [param chunk_size] and returns the batch tag. Returns [code]0[/code] when the native singletons or the stream driver autoload ([code]DSRuntime[/code]) are unavailable. [b]Note:[/b] A texture is eligible for the GPU path when its payload carries v2 per-mip footprint metadata, it was not imported with [code]compatibility/as_image_texture[/code], and its format is either a color format with an sRGB counterpart (BC1, BC2, BC3, BC7, the RGBA8/BGRA8 family) or one of the linear block formats used by 3D material data (BC4, BC5 - normal, roughness, AO and height maps). Uncompressed and float data formats (R8, RG8, RGB8, the R16 family, float formats, BC6H) always stay on the memory path and arrive as [ImageTexture] even when GPU prewarm is active. Non-multiple-of-4 textures are GPU-eligible, but the resulting [Texture2DRD] reports the padded storage dimensions (the engine exposes no size setter); enable [code]compatibility/as_image_texture[/code] when [method Texture2D.get_width] must report the authoring size.
